name: HEXTAR
recent: Hextar Global 在2026年11月16日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，营收为RM202.4百万，净利为RM13.6百万。并拟与Kotaputeri Development成立合资公司进行综合开发项目，相关议案将在12月10日的特别股东大会表决。此外，副董事长Dato' Ong Soon Ho在11月于闭门期内外均有间接持股的出售记录。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收RM202.4百万，净利RM13.6百万。
risks: 副董事长Dato' Ong Soon Ho在2026年11月6日及10日间接出售共13,888,800股普通股。
副董事长Dato' Ong Soon Ho在2026年10月7日间接增持780,000股普通股。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为RM202.4百万，环比增长1.7%，同比下降12.8%；净利为RM13.6百万，环比下降10.1%，同比下降14.4%；净利率为6.7%，低于上一季度的7.6%。

recent_en: Hextar Global reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026, with revenue of RM202.4 million and net profit of RM13.6 million. The company proposes to diversify into property development, construction, and property investment and management, and plans a joint venture with Kotaputeri Development for a mixed-use development project, to be tabled at an EGM on 10 December. In addition, Vice Chairman Dato' Ong Soon Ho recorded indirect share disposals in November, both during and outside the closed period.
notable_en: Proposed diversification into property development, construction, and property investment and management.
Proposed joint venture with Kotaputeri Development through Hextar Siera for a mixed-use development project.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM202.4 million and net profit of RM13.6 million.
risks_en: Vice Chairman Dato' Ong Soon Ho indirectly disposed a total of 13,888,800 ordinary shares on 6 and 10 November 2026.
Vice Chairman Dato' Ong Soon Ho indirectly acquired 780,000 ordinary shares on 7 October 2026.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM202.4 million, up 1.7% QoQ but down 12.8% YoY; net profit was RM13.6 million, down 10.1% QoQ and 14.4% YoY; net margin was 6.7%, lower than 7.6% in the previous quarter.
